entities.summary: Đuro Macut is a Serbian endocrinologist and academic serving as the prime minister of Serbia since 2025. Although not a member of any political party, Macut became one of the founding members of the Movement for the People and the State in March 2025, which is led by President Aleksandar Vučić. He is the third independent politician to be nominated to the position of prime minister.
